description: This file is a stylesheet source file defining typography styles, headers, body text, emphasis, alignment, colors, page headers, lists, blockquotes, and other miscellaneous styles for a Bootstrap-based theme (specifically 'SuiteP' theme in the SuiteCRM project). It contains styled class definitions, media queries, and mixins for styling web page text and layout.
external_files: mixins for `text-emphasis-variant` and `bg-variant` likely included from other stylesheet files
external_methods: Mixin methods: `@include text-emphasis-variant`, `@include bg-variant`, `@include list-unstyled`, `@include clearfix`, `@include text-overflow`
